outcome: incidence of severe intraventricular hemorrhage (IVH) (Grade III-IV)
cohort: Very low birth weight infants (<32 weeks' gestational age) born at centers of the NEOCOSUR Network between January 2015 and December 2020.
finding: Antenatal magnesium sulfate was associated with a significantly decreased death rate after admission and severe intraventricular hemorrhage/death, but no significant reduction in severe intraventricular hemorrhage alone was observed.
